title: Contours drawn on top of the Cooper marl in the Ladson quadrangle, South Carolina
citation: Colquhoun, D.J., 1961, Contours drawn on top of the Cooper marl in the Ladson quadrangle, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Map Series MS-4, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR page (map sheet). The text panels (Purpose and Scope, Use of Map, Geology, Cooper Marl Surface, References) OCR cleanly and were read. The map face (contour values, power/hand auger hole and seismic station elevations such as '+8'', '+20'', 'A-8') is badly garbled and cannot be tied to holes or locations, so no observations were recorded; a person should read them from the map image. The Cooper Marl age is not stated on the sheet.
Image re-read of the map face (page 1): every legible power auger hole, hand auger hole, seismic station and miscellaneous-control symbol with its printed elevation of the top of the Cooper Marl, recorded as surfaces (datum mean sea level as printed for the map), with hole and shaft labels as observations; and the legible Cooper Marl contour labels. Which number belongs to which symbol is read from the layout, so all map-face values are flagged inferred. The explanation's sample symbols (BERK #28 +20', 246 +8', +10', -8', +5', +10') are not recorded. No locations are recorded (none printed beyond place names near symbols). Contour labels whose sign or digit was hidden by linework were skipped. One seismic station near the northeast corner reads 2' with its sign hidden (unclear). Hole 236 carries a star (the corner note prints a star with Anomalous). The text panels are re-recorded as before.
